summary: VHC Talent OS - Shareable Job Links, Structured Job ID & JD Parsing Features Testing Complete. All 16 backend tests pass. All frontend components verified working correctly.
passed_tests: ✅ FEATURE 1 - SHAREABLE JOB LINK + PUBLIC JOB LANDING PAGE:
- GET /api/public/jobs returns only jobs with career_page_status=live AND shareable_link_enabled=true
- GET /api/public/jobs/{job_id} returns job details with job_public_id, title, description, company alias
- Hidden jobs (not live or shareable disabled) correctly return 404 on public endpoint
- PUT /api/jobs/{job_id}/shareable-link requires authentication
- Shareable link can only be enabled for jobs with career_page_status=live
- POST /api/public/apply requires consent_given=true
- Application stores consent metadata (timestamp, IP, policy version)
- Honeypot field (website) provides bot protection
- Rate limiting on public apply endpoint (5 per minute per IP)
✅ FEATURE 2 - STRUCTURED JOB ID FORMAT:
- Job creation generates job_public_id in VHC/YYYY/NNNN format
- Sequence increments correctly for each new job
- Existing test job has correct ID: VHC/2026/0001
✅ FEATURE 3 - JD PARSING DURING JOB CREATION:
- POST /api/jobs/parse-jd requires authentication (admin/employer/recruiter only)
- JD parsing requires either jd_text or jd_file input
- JD parsing returns structured fields (title, skills, experience, location, etc.)
✅ FRONTEND - PublicJobPage.jsx:
- Page loads at /jobs/{jobId} without authentication
- Job Public ID badge (VHC/2026/0001) displayed
- Company alias shown instead of real company name
- Apply Now button shows application form
- Application form has: resume upload, name, email, phone, current_salary, notice_period
- Consent checkbox present and required
- Submit Application button present
✅ FRONTEND - ApplicationSuccessPage.jsx:
- Page loads at /application-success
- THANK YOU heading is uppercase and bold
- Subheading is italic
- View More Jobs button present
✅ FRONTEND - Admin JobsPage.jsx:
- Job Public ID badge displayed for each job
- Live status badge shown for live jobs
- Shareable link toggle present for live jobs
- Copy link and external link buttons available when shareable enabled
- Career page control buttons (post/remove) present
✅ FRONTEND - CreateJobPage.jsx:
- AI Job Description Parser section present
- Use AI Parser button expands parser section
- JD Parser input textarea available
- Parse JD button available
- All form fields present (title, location, job_type, description, etc.)
